subject: extracting factor scores from mixedmirt object

messages.author: e60b8a7ba4100d3e
messages.subject: extracting factor scores from mixedmirt object
parts:
Hello,

I built a model with mixedmirt with something like this:
t<-mirt::mixedmirt(testdata, covdata=testdata_cov,
                   model=3, fixed = ~ 0 + group,
                   random = list(~ 1|group),
                   itemtype = "graded")
When I tried to extract factor scores with mirt::fscores function, it said:
> mirt::fscores(t)
Error in (function (classes, fdef, mtable) : unable to find an inherited method for function ‘fscores.internal’ for signature ‘"MixedClass"’  

According to readme,  MixedClass now only supports coef, print, residuals, summary, anova, show, logLik, anova methods. And mirt::fscores seem to support class SingleGroupClass, MultipleGroupClass, or DiscreteClass now.

I'd like to know if I can get factor scores(for each observation) from mixmirt analyzing results.

I must rebuild a model with latent regression formula in mirt::mixedmirt function accompanying lr.fixed argument, and extract factor score from the model with mirt::fixef function?

Thank you!

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: extracting factor scores from mixedmirt object
parts:
I think you want to use the randef() function as well to obtain sampled values of the random effects, which the latent traits are a class of. The fixef() function will extract the regression implied expected values due to the model covariates, while randef() the residuals, so you should be able to simply just add these together to obtain the specific values of the latent traits given the modeled fixed and random effects. HTH.

Phil
